correctness.rationale: The Young-deficit identity is exact for signed cyclic ℓp coordinates. Equality and parity cases follow from strict convexity and sign conjugacy. The power map transforms the nonlinear coercive deficit into a Sobolev Dirichlet energy; local quotient tends exactly to 2(p−1)/p², with a global coercive lower constant and a same-sign upper constant. Compact H1 convergence, localization off the zero set, antiperiodic Poincaré and sine recovery prove matching liminf and limsup. Finite verification independently tests local identities and the Hilbert anchor, not the infinite limit.
